entities.summary: Asmawi bin Ani, better known by his stage name Mawi is a Malaysian singer and winner of the Third Season of Malaysia's popular reality show, Akademi Fantasia. His father is a blacksmith in his hometown of Kulai. Mawi was a performers & entertainers from Kulai (b. 1981-08-25, Kulai). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
